_why: What Is Nueva, rep-facing. Built 2026-09-24 alongside the funnel itself.
THIS FUNNEL HAS NO OPT-IN AND NO LEAD MAGNET. It is one page a rep sends to someone who has
already asked what they do, plus this page explaining when to send it. So there is no guide
link, no confirmation page and no drip: the whole campaign is a link and a conversation.
VIDEOS ARE EMPTY ON PURPOSE, same as Nueva's other four how-to pages. Jeff, 2026-09-23:
'nueva how to funnel vids coming soon'. A page with no video is honest where a page with a
competitor's video is not. Add them here and re-run the generator.
NO CANVA CARD. Every other Nueva funnel has a social file; this one has none yet, and a card
pointing at another funnel's file would send reps to the wrong creative.
NO ADS SECTION, for the same reason as the other four: Nueva has no seller-side domain yet,
so there is nothing truthful to point at.
UPDATED 2026-09-24: both page CTAs now open an ask modal instead of linking out. The reader
is sent to a DM redirect step, which fires a Fire Lead: tag, opportunity card, and an SMS to
the rep carrying the link to send back. Two doors, two steps, two pipelines, because the
account has a Recruitment ladder and a Customer Sales ladder and one step cannot file into
both. The rep has to KNOW this or the alert lands and they do not act on it, which is why
the sub and the first prompt card both say it.
sub: One page that answers the question you get asked most: what is it you actually do? Send it when someone has already shown interest, not before. Its two buttons do not send the reader off to buy or sign up on their own: they ask her to message you, so every serious reader ends up in your inbox and you get a text the moment it happens, with the link to send her already in it.

links.title: The page you send
links.tease: Read it yourself once. You will answer questions faster if you know exactly what they just saw.
links.label: Open the page

links.title: Your marketing links
links.tease: Every funnel link and product link in this system, in one page, with a copy button on each.
links.label: Open your marketing links

promptLabel: What happens when she clicks, and what to say

prompt.title: Both buttons send her to you
prompt.tease: "Shop as a customer" and "See how sharing works" both open a box asking her to message you. You get a text naming which one she picked, with the link to send back already written out. Open Messenger, tap Message Requests, then the Spam tab inside it: that is where a message from someone who is not your friend lands, and it stays hidden until you look.
prompt.text: Check Messenger > Message Requests > Spam. Messages from people who are not already my friend land there and stay hidden.

prompt.title: Send it like this
prompt.tease: Short, no pitch, and it gives them an easy way out. The page does the explaining, so your message does not have to.
prompt.text: Hey! You asked what I have been doing. Easier to show you than explain it over text, so here is the two minute version. Have a look when you get a minute and tell me what you think.

prompt.title: After they have read it
prompt.tease: Ask a question rather than making an offer. You are finding out whether there is real interest, not closing anything.
prompt.text: What did you think? Is it something you would want to try yourself, or does anyone come to mind who might?

prompt.title: Get post ideas from AI
prompt.tease: Paste this into Ask AI, or any AI you use, for posts that get people asking you what you do instead of you telling them.
prompt.text: I share health and wellness products on social media and earn from it. I have a single page that explains what the company is, what the products do and how the business works, and I send it to anyone who asks what I do. What could I post on social media that makes people curious enough to ask me what I do, without me pitching anything or mentioning the company by name? Give me ten ideas I could post this week.
